thread:
nina_onboard: FYI ran into an annoying auth mismatch during a customer PoC. CLI and deploy scripts picked up rotated keys, but our long-running sample app kept 401ing.

maria_sdk: ouch. repro?

nina_onboard: we mount a projected secret and replace it on rotation. CLI runs read the new file, the Node/Python sample read env at startup and cached it. SDK auth helper prefers REDWOOD_OLD_KEY over REDWOOD_API_KEY in some places.

tim_ops: so two issues: var precedence inconsistent, and import-time caching prevents live rotation.

maria_sdk: agreed. Proposal: normalize precedence -> prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY (or REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE if present), fall back to legacy var for a release cycle. Avoid import-time caching; implement file-watcher when *_FILE present and a short TTL when reading envs.

emma_docs: I'll add a migration blurb: canonical env is REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_OLD_KEY deprecated; include quick steps for k8s projected secrets and how to enable REDWOOD_ENABLE_CRED_REFRESH.

infra-bot: ISSUE CREATED: CI-10555 "env var parity and live secret rotation support in SDKs and samples" assigned to maria_sdk.
